title: Discovery of Pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyridazinone Derivatives as Selective DDR1 Inhibitors via Deep Learning Based Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation.
summary: A scaffold-design workflow incorporating a deep generative model, kinase screening and docking produced compound 2, with DDR1 IC50 10.6 ± 1.9 nM and selectivity tested against 430 kinases. Cell and mouse-colitis results are preclinical; sample sizes and comparators were not assessed from the abstract.
organization: Chinese Academy of Sciences; Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica; State Key Laboratory of Drug Research

evidence.tested: The publisher abstract reports DDR1 IC50 10.6 ± 1.9 nM, selectivity testing against 430 kinases, cell cytokine/autophosphorylation assays and a DSS-induced mouse colitis model. Sample sizes and comparator details were not available in the reviewed abstract.
evidence.unknown: Only the publisher abstract and metadata were reviewed. Animal sample size, comparator regimen, detailed assay design and the generator's specific operation were not assessed; mouse results do not establish clinical efficacy.
evidence.ai_role: The publisher abstract identifies a deep generative model within a scaffold-design workflow with kinase selectivity screening and docking; its specific operation was not assessable from the abstract.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary ACS abstract, supporting-information inventory and online/issue metadata; complete article body not reviewed.
